presets.label: Public web
presets.effect: Blocks the configured public web ports while leaving the control page reachable over another path.
presets.warning: If this page uses one of these ports, your current session will disconnect.

presets.label: All web ingress
presets.effect: Blocks every configured web ingress port, including the control page.
presets.warning: You may not be able to undo this remotely. The timer is the recovery path.

presets.label: Uplink cut
presets.effect: Blocks traffic to the configured outbound uplink port.
presets.warning: This may remove the path you use to reach the control page. The timer is the recovery path.
